Staryy Sambir Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Lviv Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Presumed established at the start of the 19th century, this large cemetery was vandalized and partly demolished during the Soviet period, then restored in the 2000s through the J. Gardner initiative — one of the more hopeful preservation stories in this collection. The Jewish community here, documented from 1544, peaked at 1,827 in 1910 before wartime deportations to Belzec in August 1942 emptied it. About 1,000 gravestones survive today, though the site remains severely overgrown and needs fencing on three sides.
